title: Early warning
description: Which subreddits pick up terms before others, and forecasts of which current bursts will reach other subreddits, groups or all of reddit. Learned from at least 4–6 weeks of history.

list.name: topic
list.label: Topic
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM propagation_edges WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM propagation_edges) ORDER BY topic = 'all' DESC, topic
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM propagation_edges WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM propagation_edges) ORDER BY topic = 'all' DESC, topic

panels.title: Edges learned
panels.description: When wgra analyze last learned the edges. It does once a day, after lead_lag.run_at (01:00 UTC).

panels.title: Edges
panels.description: Leader -> follower pairs that pass the gates in the selected topic: at least 5 events, 3 hits and a q-value of at most 0.05.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM propagation_edges FINAL WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM propagation_edges) AND topic = ${topic:sqlstring}

panels.title: Events, closed
panels.description: Terms that trended somewhere, the unit edges are learned from. An event is closed when its span (3 days before its first trend to 14 days after) is over; only closed events count for base rates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS events, countIf(closed) AS closed FROM lead_lag_events FINAL
SELECT count() FROM forecasts FINAL WHERE outcome = 'pending'

panels.title: Forecasts that came true, 30 days
panels.description: Precision of the forecasts resolved in the last 30 days. `wgra replay --forecast` measures it on past data, with recall and calibration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, countIf(outcome = 'hit') / count()) FROM forecasts FINAL WHERE outcome IN ('hit', 'miss') AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.title: Forecast alerts, 24h
panels.description: Forecast alerts are off by default (forecast.alert in config.yaml). They share the daily alert cap with trend alerts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM notifications WHERE kind = 'forecast' AND ok AND sent_at > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Leader -> follower edges
panels.description: Learned daily from the events of the last 180 days. lead: median time from the leader's onset (the first hour its last 24h crossed 2x its usual share, z 3) to the follower's, IQR in days. n: the leader's onsets the follower hadn't crossed before, with a known outcome. hit_rate: of those, followed within 7 days. base_rate: the share of all events in which the follower crossed at all. probability: the hit rate shrunk to the base rate by 4 pseudo-events, with its 80% interval. lift: probability / base rate. q: one-sided binomial test of the hits against the base rate, Benjamini–Hochberg over all pairs. '(rest)': a group of the leader's, without the leader's own mentions. Edges need 4–6 weeks of history to mean anything.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    leader,
    if(without_leader, concat(follower, ' (rest)'), follower) AS follower,
    follower_type AS type,
    lag_median AS lead,
    concat(toString(round(lag_q25 / 24, 1)), '–', toString(round(lag_q75 / 24, 1)), 'd')
        AS lead_iqr,
    events AS n,
    hits,
    hit_rate,
    base_rate,
    probability,
    concat(toString(round(100 * probability_low)), '–',
           toString(round(100 * probability_high)), '%') AS interval,
    round(lift, 1) AS lift,
    q_value AS q,
    leader_onsets
FROM propagation_edges FINAL
WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM propagation_edges) AND topic = ${topic:sqlstring} AND leader IN (${leader:singlequote})
ORDER BY lift DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Who leads whom
panels.description: The edges of the table above as a graph: arrows from leaders to followers, labeled with the median lead in days and the lift. A node's number is the edges it's part of.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scope AS id, scope AS title, toFloat64(count()) AS mainstat
FROM (
    SELECT leader AS scope FROM propagation_edges FINAL WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM propagation_edges) AND topic = ${topic:sqlstring} AND leader IN (${leader:singlequote})
    UNION ALL
    SELECT if(without_leader, concat(follower, ' (rest)'), follower) FROM propagation_edges FINAL WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM propagation_edges) AND topic = ${topic:sqlstring} AND leader IN (${leader:singlequote})
)
GROUP BY scope

SELECT concat(leader, ' -> ', if(without_leader, concat(follower, ' (rest)'), follower)) AS id, leader AS source, if(without_leader, concat(follower, ' (rest)'), follower) AS target,
       concat(toString(round(lag_median / 24, 1)), 'd') AS mainstat,
       concat('lift ', toString(round(lift, 1))) AS secondarystat
FROM propagation_edges FINAL
WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM propagation_edges) AND topic = ${topic:sqlstring} AND leader IN (${leader:singlequote})

panels.title: Recent cascades
panels.description: Events of the last 14 days that reached more than one scope, with every scope's onset in the order they crossed (UTC). This is what the edges are learned from. reached: the scopes that crossed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    term,
    start AS first_trend,
    topic,
    arrayStringConcat(
        arrayMap(o -> concat(o.1, ' ', formatDateTime(o.3, '%d %b %H:00')),
                 arraySort(o -> o.3, arrayFilter(o -> o.2 = '', onsets))),
        ' → ') AS cascade,
    length(arrayFilter(o -> o.2 = '', onsets)) AS reached,
    closed
FROM lead_lag_events FINAL
WHERE start > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND length(onsets) > 1
ORDER BY start DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Current forecasts
panels.description: A term rising in a leader that the follower hasn't picked up yet: the chance it will within 7 days of the leader's onset (the edge's probability, lowered for the time that already passed), against the follower's base rate, and when it's expected (the leader's onset plus the edge's median lead). Click a term to see it in the leader.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    term,
    leader,
    if(without_leader, concat(follower, ' (rest)'), follower) AS follower,
    probability AS chance,
    concat(toString(round(100 * probability_low)), '–',
           toString(round(100 * probability_high)), '%') AS interval,
    base_rate,
    expected_at,
    due_by,
    leader_onset,
    created_at,
    edge_events AS n,
    round(lift, 1) AS lift,
    alert,
    concat('/d/wgra-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), if(startsWith(leader, 'r/'), concat('&var-group=tracked&var-subreddit=', encodeURLFormComponent(substring(leader, 3))), concat('&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(leader))), '&from=now-7d&to=now') AS explore
FROM forecasts FINAL
WHERE outcome = 'pending'
ORDER BY probability DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Track record, last 30 days
panels.description: Resolved forecasts: hit when the follower crossed by the due time, miss otherwise. warning: hours from the forecast to the follower's onset. lag: from the leader's onset to the follower's, against the lag the edge expected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    created_at,
    term,
    leader,
    if(without_leader, concat(follower, ' (rest)'), follower) AS follower,
    probability AS chance,
    outcome,
    dateDiff('hour', created_at, follower_onset) AS warning,
    dateDiff('hour', leader_onset, follower_onset) AS lag,
    round(lag_median) AS expected_lag,
    concat('/d/wgra-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), if(startsWith(follower, 'r/'), concat('&var-group=tracked&var-subreddit=', encodeURLFormComponent(substring(follower, 3))), concat('&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(follower))), '&from=now-7d&to=now') AS explore
FROM forecasts FINAL
WHERE outcome IN ('hit', 'miss') AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Calibration, last 90 days
panels.description: Well calibrated forecasts come true about as often as they say. The base rate column is what always forecasting the follower's usual rate would say.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toUInt8(floor(least(probability, 0.999) * 5)) AS bin,
    concat(toString(bin * 20), '–', toString(bin * 20 + 20), '%') AS predicted_bin,
    count() AS forecasts,
    avg(probability) AS predicted,
    countIf(outcome = 'hit') / count() AS came_true,
    avg(base_rate) AS base_rate
FROM forecasts FINAL
WHERE outcome IN ('hit', 'miss') AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY bin
ORDER BY bin

panels.title: Forecasts per day, and how many came true

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time,
       countIf(outcome = 'hit') AS came_true,
       countIf(outcome = 'miss') AS missed,
       countIf(outcome = 'pending') AS pending
FROM forecasts FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Reddit vs Wikipedia (optional)
panels.description: With wikipedia.enabled: for events whose term names a Wikipedia article, did daily pageviews rise (3x their 28-day median, at least 100) after the term's first onset on reddit? `wgra wikipedia` prints a sign test.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    count() AS events,
    countIf(wiki_onset IS NOT NULL) AS with_interest,
    countIf(lead_days > 0) AS reddit_first,
    countIf(lead_days = 0) AS same_day,
    countIf(lead_days < 0) AS wikipedia_first,
    quantileExactIf(0.5)(lead_days, lead_days IS NOT NULL) AS median_lead_days
FROM wiki_leads FINAL
WHERE start > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
